newsitem.title: USA: CSCE to lower margins on coffee futures.
newsitem.headline: CSCE to lower margins on coffee futures.

text.p: Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange Inc (CSCE) said Monday it will decrease margins on the July "C" coffee contract to $7,000, including a $3,000 spot charge, and on the September "C" contract to $6,000, including a $2,000 spot charge, effective July 15.
The current original margin required for the July 1997 contract is $9,000, including a $3,000 spot charge, while September's margin is $8,000, including a $2,000 spot charge.
The margin on all other coffee contracts will be decreased by $2,000, to $4,000, the exchange said in a statement.
For customers who are not exchange members or a member of the trade, margins will be 140 percent above trade rates, CSCE said. ((--Patricia Avidan, New York Commodities Desk, 212 859 1640))
